method: Per-turn tokens, cost and timing from the Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<run worktree>/*.jsonl incl. subagents) and Codex rollouts (~/.codex/sessions, matched by cwd) of every story run; Claude cost recomputed from model-card prices with 1h cache writes at 2x input (matches the CLI cost-state to the cent); Codex cost from token counts at card prices. Wall time: union of turn spans per phase; orchestration = wall minus all turn spans (session spawns, Jev, checks, cards, git).
